Portal releases (10): all reviewed before release. Export files from 2021 (10): all retrievable. Media disposals (10 of 10): all with certificates. Plant 2 visitor log (40 July 2026 entries): 9 missing an exit time. Plant 1 OEM sessions (20 of 212): all approved and recorded. Field laptops (8 of 8): can save utility passwords. Subcontracts with federal drawings (3 of 3): the outside tank fabricator's purchase order lacks the FAR 52.204-21 flow-down. Supplier bank detail changes (20): 2 verified by email reply

title: Monthly security review minutes and metrics packs, 2026-04 to 2026-07
source_system: Security review minutes; monthly metrics packs
what_it_shows: 4 sampled monthly meetings attended by the COO, vCISO, Security Manager and IT Director; Plant Managers, the VP Engineering and Digital Services are not regular members; supplier risks arrive only by email; metrics cover patching, phishing and incidents for IT, with no OT, product or FMS metrics

title: Carrier confirmation of the panel OT response firm
source_system: Email from the cyber insurance carrier
what_it_shows: The carrier confirms that its panel OT-capable response firm is available to the company for incidents affecting plant systems

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: IdP and ERP user exports; MES user lists (both plants); POL-02; ERP quarterly review records Q1-Q2 2026; samples of 25 terminations, 25 transfers and 25 new accounts; IT Director and Production Planning Manager interviews
what_it_shows: Terminations (25 of the 214 in EV-003): 6 production MES accounts kept access 2 to 9 days. Transfers (25 of 71): 5 kept prior ERP roles more than 30 days. The Plant 2 MES has 3 shared supervisor override accounts in daily use, with passwords unchanged since 2024 although 2 supervisors left in 2026. ERP access is reviewed quarterly; MES, OT and OEM accounts have never been reviewed. MES administrators and the Director of Field Service are not notified of terminations or transfers

title: Control assessment: information flow enforcement
source_system: Firewall rule bases (cloud hub, Plant 1 IT/OT, Plant 2 site firewall); reachability tests from office workstations at Plant 1 (2026-08-08) and Plant 2 (2026-08-15)
what_it_shows: Flows are enforced at the cloud hub and the Plant 1 IT/OT firewall, and the Plant 1 test reached no plant zone; at Plant 2 an office workstation reached 14 HMIs, 3 test PCs and the drying oven controller on industrial protocol ports

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Privileged account list (41); Domain Admins membership export (2026-08-12); broker logs; Plant 2 domain trust configuration
what_it_shows: The Plant 2 MES service account is a member of the corporate Domain Admins group through the two-way trust, with a password last set in 2019 (reported 2026-08-12; rights removed 2026-08-19); 7 ERP super users against a target of 3

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: VPN configuration; Plant 1 gateway policy and 20 of 212 session records; Plant 2 router configurations; OT Security Engineer interview
what_it_shows: The office VPN and the Plant 1 gateway have documented configuration and connection requirements; the 4 Plant 2 OEM cellular routers have none, were found powered on with shared logins, and accept connections at any time without prior authorization

title: Control assessment: literacy training
source_system: LMS completion report 2026; phishing reports Q1-Q2 2026; training content; interviews with 15 randomly selected staff (8 office, 7 production)
what_it_shows: Office staff 96% complete, with quarterly phishing and a privacy module on employee data; production workers and field technicians receive orientation content only; 5 of 7 production staff interviewed could not describe how to report a suspicious event on an HMI; content not updated after the 2026 late utility notices, the Plant 2 acquisition or the 2025 tabletop

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list; MSSP onboarding records; ERP audit settings; Plant 2 MES database settings; STD-02 draft
what_it_shows: Identity, cloud, ERP, firewall, VPN, EDR and Plant 1 OT sensor events are logged and coordinated with the MSSP; event types for both MES instances, the integration platform and the historians are not identified; audit logging is off on the Plant 2 MES database; the rationale for the selected event types appears only in the draft STD-02

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports May-July 2026; ERP super-user review sign-offs; simulated impossible-travel sign-in (2026-08-11)
what_it_shows: The MSSP escalated the simulated sign-in in 18 minutes against a 30-minute target; findings are reported monthly; no review of MES, historian or OT events; the monthly ERP super-user review was skipped in May 2026; the review level is unchanged since the Plant 2 acquisition

title: Control assessment: information exchange
source_system: Interconnection list (draft); EDI, bank and ERP vendor agreements; Plant 1 OT DMZ design; Plant 2 trust and MES file-drop configuration
what_it_shows: External exchanges are covered by contracts; exchanges with the Plant 2 MES, the PLM vault and the Plant 2 domain trust have no documented interface characteristics, security requirements, controls or responsibilities; exchange agreements have no review schedule

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration
source_system: Image pipeline and guardrail list; Plant 1 OT DMZ baseline document; benchmark scan of 10 servers (6 cloud, 2 Plant 1 DMZ, 2 Plant 2)
what_it_shows: Cloud workloads and Plant 1 OT DMZ servers have documented baselines that are reviewed and updated; no baseline exists for the Plant 2 MES server or the 22 Plant 2 kiosks; replacement Plant 2 kiosks installed in 2025 were not added to any baseline

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: Change advisory board records; 15 of about 140 ERP changes; 15 of about 60 Plant 2 MES changes
what_it_shows: 15 of 15 sampled ERP, integration and cloud changes had records and approval; 4 of 15 sampled Plant 2 MES changes had no record or security review; Plant 2 MES change decisions are not documented, monitored or reviewed

title: Control assessment: least functionality
source_system: Endpoint policies; service scan of 5 Plant 2 kiosks and the MES server (2026-08-15); USB test
what_it_shows: Plant 2 kiosks and the MES server run remote desktop and file sharing services; a USB test device mounted on 5 of 5 Plant 2 kiosks; USB storage and services are restricted on office endpoints and Plant 1 HMIs

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: CMDB export; Plant 1 OT sensor inventory; Plant 2 kiosk and server walkdown (all 22 kiosks)
what_it_shows: IT and Plant 1 components are inventoried; 3 of 22 Plant 2 kiosks found on the floor are not in the inventory; Plant 2 MES-connected devices are not all included; support status and end-of-life dates are not recorded

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: IT DR plan (2024); BIA (P05); contact list; distribution records; IT Director, Plant Managers and Director of Digital Services interviews
what_it_shows: The 2024 IT DR plan covers the ERP and integration platform and is approved by the IT Director only; it does not identify the plant functions that depend on the MES and has no BIA-aligned objectives, restoration priorities, metrics, Plant 2 production procedure or full MES or landing zone restoration procedure; 3 of 11 named contacts have left; not distributed to Plant Managers or Digital Services; not reviewed since 2024; no contingency training has been held

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Restore test record 2025-04; restore of one ERP database daily copy from the backup account into an isolated recovery account (2026-08-18)
what_it_shows: The database restore completed and the database was available in 9 hours; the application stack was not attempted; the only earlier test is the 2025 file-level restore; no tests are defined against the BIA RTOs or for the MES or OT

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports (31 of 31 July 2026 days); vault lock settings; Plant 2 MES backup configuration; Plant 2 controller program copies on a laptop
what_it_shows: 31 of 31 July job days complete and copies locked for the ERP, FMS and PLM; Plant 1 OT backups run nightly with weekly offline copies; the Plant 2 MES backs up to a local disk on the same server; Plant 2 controller programs are hand copies, the latest from 2026-04

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: DR plan (2024); 2026-08-18 restore test; infrastructure templates
what_it_shows: Recovery to a known state within the 24-hour ERP RTO was not demonstrated (the database alone took 9 hours); no reconstitution procedure for the MES or a full landing zone rebuild

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP export; MES user lists; sign-in tests on 10 sampled accounts
what_it_shows: Office users are uniquely identified; Plant 2 MES supervisor overrides and Plant 2 HMI operator logins are shared

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Conditional access policy; MFA sign-in test on 25 of 41 privileged accounts; MES administrator and OT engineering workstation account review
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled identity provider privileged accounts were prompted for MFA; the 6 MES administrator accounts and the local administrator accounts on 24 OT engineering workstations have no MFA

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Authenticator standard; vault inventory; default credential test of 20 Plant 2 devices (2026-08-15: switches, HMI web interfaces, kiosks)
what_it_shows: 2 of 20 tested Plant 2 network switches accepted vendor default management credentials; the Plant 2 MES service account password was last set in 2019; shared supervisor passwords unchanged since 2024; group and role account authenticators are not changed when members leave

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: IR plan (2024); incident register (10 of 41 incidents); 2025 tabletop report; MSSP escalation test (2026-08-11); Plant 1 isolation procedure
what_it_shows: 10 of 10 sampled IT incidents handled from preparation to closure; Plant 2 has no isolation points, OT tools or verified program copies and cannot be contained without stopping the plant; OT eradication and recovery are not planned; incident handling is not coordinated with contingency planning; Plant 2 handles events locally without the security team

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03 (2024 and 2026); obligations register; 2026 notice emails; interviews with 15 staff
what_it_shows: 13 of 15 staff knew how to report; 2 utility access-revocation notices were late (business days 4 and 6) and 1 vulnerability disclosure went out on day 41

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: IR plan (2024); distribution list; Security Manager and COO interviews
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan covers IT incidents and is approved by the IT Director only; it does not cover OT, products supplied to utilities or the FMS, defines no reportable incidents under the addenda or FAR clauses, and has no metrics; not distributed to Plant Managers or Controls Leads; not updated for the Plant 2 acquisition or the FMS

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Plant 1 gateway policy and records (20 of 212 sessions); Plant 2 router configurations and power state (2026-08-15); Plant 2 Controls Lead interview
what_it_shows: 20 of 20 sampled Plant 1 sessions approved, MFA-protected, recorded and closed; Plant 2 OEM sessions are not approved, monitored or recorded, use shared OEM logins, and the router connections stay up permanently

title: Control assessment: physical access
source_system: Badge reports; key register; visitor logs (Plant 2 July: 40 entries); walkthroughs of 3 server rooms and 2 control rooms
what_it_shows: Badge access, logs and visitor controls work at HQ and Plant 1; an OEM technician worked unescorted in the Plant 2 control room on 2026-07-15; the Plant 2 server room key is held by 9 people, and the lock was not changed after 2 key holders left in 2026

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: HR termination report; 25 of 214 terminations; badge return records; exit interview forms
what_it_shows: 6 of 25 sampled production terminations kept MES access more than 1 business day; 3 of 25 sampled Plant 2 badges were not collected and stayed active for up to 5 days; exit interviews and property return recorded

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 register and report; P05 BIA; audit committee materials
what_it_shows: SP 800-30 assessment of 52 risks, including risks to employees and applicants, documented, reviewed and disseminated

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scan reports Q1-Q2 2026; 50 critical findings; scanner configuration
what_it_shows: IT and cloud systems are scanned and reported; the Plant 2 MES, kiosks and OT are not scanned or monitored; 4 of 50 critical findings were remediated after the target

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Contracts and vendor files for 7 Tier 1 suppliers; SOC 2 reports on file
what_it_shows: Security requirements appear in contracts; compliance is not evidenced for 4 of 7 sampled Tier 1 providers (no SOC 2 report or equivalent on file, including the EDI provider); oversight is defined at onboarding only; no ongoing monitoring of provider control compliance

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Hub and site firewall rule bases; Plant 1 IT/OT rule base; Plant 2 reachability test (2026-08-15); FMS account route tables
what_it_shows: External interfaces are protected and monitored at all sites and in the cloud; the internal interface between the Plant 2 office and plant networks is neither monitored nor controlled, and the Plant 2 MES is dual-homed

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; 50 critical findings; Plant 2 MES and kiosk patch levels; change records
what_it_shows: IT and cloud flaws are identified, reported and corrected; the Plant 2 MES server and kiosks were last patched 2025-11; 4 of 50 critical updates were installed after the target; 2 of 6 Plant 2 switches are more than a year behind on security firmware; Plant 2 firmware updates are not tested before installation

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR console; EICAR test on 5 endpoints at HQ and Plant 1; Plant 1 allowlisting report; Plant 2 MES and kiosk check
what_it_shows: All 5 test files were quarantined within 3 minutes and alerted to the MSSP; Plant 1 HMIs are allowlisted; no malicious code protection on the Plant 2 MES server, its 22 kiosks or the Plant 2 HMIs on the same network

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM use cases; Plant 1 OT sensor; MSSP escalation test (2026-08-11); Plant 2 network walkdown; monitoring legal opinion (2024)
what_it_shows: IT, cloud, identity and Plant 1 are monitored; Plant 2 networks and both MES instances are not; 2 rogue access points were found in the Plant 2 walkdown; remote connections through the Plant 2 routers are not detected; no internal monitoring device at Plant 2; monitoring was not adjusted after the acquisition

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Vendor files for 7 Tier 1 suppliers; STD-03 draft
what_it_shows: Suppliers, including OEMs with plant access and the TMU electronics supplier, are assessed at onboarding only; annual Tier 1 reviews appear only in the draft STD-03
